messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-inference-queue-backpressure severity=critical — INC-2026-089. Auto-route to @mira, @devon.
pagerduty-bot: page sent: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-089 — please ack.
mira: acked — oncall for inference this shift. I'm starting triage.
mira: quick snapshot: queue depth ~41.8k, consumer-rate dropped 30% last 10m, p95 latency 1.5s -> 2.1s, backend error rate +3%. autoscaler desired=18 running=10.
samir: grabbing scale-controller logs and recent node events. attaching tail output.
samir: ```
scale-controller-7f8c9d6f9 log: failed to provision nodes: quotaExceeded: "RequestedResourceCount exceeds quota"
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z scaler: evaluateDesiredReplicas current=10 target=18 provisioning=0
2026-03-15T02:12:18Z kube-api: Node creation accepted, provisioning pending
```
devon: seeing GCE quota errors on the cloud console — compute instances quota at 100% for region-us-west1. No spare capacity to spin new nodes.
leo: contacting infra channel and cloud account team to request temporary quota bump now. pinging cloud-ops.
anya: customer impact check: degraded responses for prod inference routes, throttles triggered for large customers A & C. 12 support requests open, some customers report errors on LLM requests.
mira: mitigation plan: 1) manual routing to lower-capacity model variants for non-SLAs 2) increase shared reserved pool on dedicated cluster 3) fallback to warm standby region for highest-severity tenants.
ops-rotation: handing off to @devon for quota escalation + manual node spin. mira, keep me posted on customer fallback.
devon: attempting manual spin via managed-instance-group: ```gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize mig-inference-usw1 --size 6 --project redwood-prod``` — starts, but instances stuck in PROVISIONING due to quota.
leo: cloud-ops responded, opened case CS-7892, requested emergency quota increase of +20 CPUs. ETA ~8-12m.
samir: while we wait, I'm enabling aggressive batching and increasing the rate-limit window to reduce headroom for hotpaths. Pushing quick config to routing:
```json
{"route_overrides": {"/v1/generate": {"model_preference": ["redwood-small","redwood-medium"], "batch_size": 32}}}
```
mira: applied override to 20% of traffic via canary (route tag canary-scale). Monitoring error-rate and latency.
anya: incident severity: critical -> customer-impacting. Notifying CS and SRE leads; draft message to customers ready.
pagerduty-bot: escalation: page escalated to secondary rotation @samir because primary ack >8m.
samir: acked secondary. continuing with batching change + cache priming for frequent prefixes.
mira: noticing queue drain rate improved slightly after batching change 6m in. queue down from 41.8k -> 28.2k. latency p95 down to 1.3s.
devon: cloud quota increased by +10 CPUs earlier than expected; MIGs started 4 new instances, kube nodes joined cluster. kube nodes Ready -> 3/4 joined. autoscaler now provisioning pods.
ops-rotation: manual scale complete? verify desired replicas and HPA.
samir: HPA status: min=8 max=30 current=12 targetCPU=60% -> desirable=no immediate scale because CPU reading behind, but we have new nodes. forcing rollout to restart scale-controller to pickup new capacity: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/scale-controller -n infra```.
mira: restarting scale-controller; logs show reconnect and provisioning loop resuming. queue now 11.2k and falling.
anya: CS update sent to affected customers summarizing mitigation and ETA for full recovery.
leo: cloud-ops confirmed quota uplift processed; filing postmortem on why quota headroom wasn't flagged earlier.
mira: marking this thread for handoff. final state at 02:48Z: queue drained to <2k, autoscaler back to expected behavior, no active tickets escalating. Leaving post-incident items for PM/infra: quota alerts, reserved warm nodes, improve k8s node readiness metrics.
ops-rotation: thanks team — handing back to next oncall @ops-rotation. incident-bot: INC-2026-089 resolved (status: mitigated). :white_check_mark:
